author: Steven_
body:
So, I really don't know if I should be posting this here, but still, It has something to do with gaming.

Google Fiber is internet that is Gigabyte speeds (1000mb's) 
I  got Google Fiber a day ago, and I would just like to say it's the best. (Due to my 100mb chip in my computer I only get around 95mb speeds)

I usually get around 1ms to my router, 95 download, and 95 upload. And to Avicus I get around 40ms, If you check the links you can figure out where I live. 
Here are some links:

From Google Fiber test site: https://gyazo.com/10e36fb5b18845dca5e06bbeeef237f1
From Speedtest.net: https://gyazo.com/518422afe0e11d1d36931dc9fc2dd53e
